note: What a person saw when they looked at each GPU run's stills and frames (the founder's reviewer). A rejected product is still evaluated, so its numbers show the failure, but it gets no renders and is left off the blind page. A faulty product is evaluated and rendered so the fault can be seen, but it is not a panel bundle and is left off the blind page. Verdicts: accepted, faulty, rejected. Bottoms may carry "waistReading": "natural" (the default: the chart's waist read at our waist ring) or { "kind": "low-rise", "decision": "<who, when>" } (the founder's recorded choice to read it at the garment's own lower band with a stated body offset, src/lowRise.ts; flagged in the report, qa.json and by the import gate).

crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt.why: DECISION 8 Nov 2026: the founder (Elmer Emanuels, in chat) chose option A: the skirt is read LOW-RISE ("waistReading" below). That accepts the low-rise reading of the waist, nothing else. ACCEPTED PENDING FOUNDER REVIEW, as azure: a panel bundle with known defects, flagged, not repaired: (1) the hem is drawn over the feet (in the stills themselves): hem 2.2 cm above the floor, pinched to 86 cm round the ankles, foot lobes at the hem and the grey toes just below it in the viewer; (2) stage 2 hem flaps: translucent pale side panels in turntable_b 81-84, a flat red tongue on the floor in 83-94, a hem flare in turntable_a 1-14, so the hem girth is UNCONFIRMED; (3) the baked print is smeared into vertical streaks with pale unprinted patches at the hem; (4) AU 8 / 12 / 16 barely differ in the viewer (graded from the hip only), the weakest point for a size panel; (5) the low-rise reading itself: the chart is our AU body chart, the shop says nothing about where the band sits. Earlier record, unchanged: run 17d (stage 2 + 4 on the reviewed stills front fashn@44 + back fashn@63 from run 17c, recomposed with QA 0.12.0): THE HIPS ARE CLOSED (run 15's fault): no grey hip beside the skirt in any front or back frame (at most 3 px against run 15's up to 1,356 px, >50 px in 46 of 62 such frames), no side slit in any side view, and the asset has no opening wider than 4 cm anywhere between 3 and 99 cm above the floor (run 15: open at both hips, 10.2 and 7.8 cm across); pale pink smocked waistband front and back, print and tier band right; hip 110.35 cm by the tape against the chart's 109 with ease (+1.35); holdout IoU 0.947 / 0.947 (run 15 0.915 / 0.883). Open, flagged, not repaired: (1) no girth at the chart's only critical anchor: the band's top edge is 100.2 cm above the floor, 4.0 cm below our waist ring (104.2), so chart agreement FAILS (band girth 88.07 cm against 80.5 with ease, +7.57, uncalibrated, global scale 1.000) and the plugin's import gate refuses the bundle (qa_failed): it is NOT in the demo shop; (2) the hem is drawn over the feet: red 'boots' round both feet below the hem in most of turntable_b (85-159) and in turntable_a 40-49, so the asset's hem sits 2.2 cm above the floor (P0's maxi 11.4) and pinches in round the ankles (hem girth 86.0 cm, flare 0.78 against the hip; P0 1.25, 3.9 sigma), two foot-shaped lobes at the hem in the viewer, the grey toes just below it; (3) stage 2 flaps: translucent pale side panels on both sides of the hem in turntable_b 81-84 and a flat red tongue on the floor at the image-left in 83-94 (consistency 0.4.0 off-reference turntable_b j1-6, up to 1,504 px; the tongue mostly under the threshold), and the hem flaring out at the image-right in turntable_a 1-14 (up to 1,928 px), j71-79 (489) and b j79 (524); so the hem girth is UNCONFIRMED; (4) the baked print is smeared into vertical streaks in the viewer, with pale unprinted patches at the hem (texture holdout MAE 29.2 against one colour 34.4); (5) AU 8 / 12 / 16 differ only a little in the viewer (graded from the hip only). FAULTY, not a panel bundle, pending a founder decision: the founder's objection (the hips) is gone and no slit or hole shows, but the bundle fails the plugin's own import gate (no girth at its only critical anchor), so no shop could show it, and the grey toes show just below the hem drawn over the feet; AU 8 / 12 / 16 barely differ, which a size-picking panel needs. The founder decides whether the skirt is worn low (then the chart's waist anchor must move to the band) or new stills are needed whose band reaches the waist. Consistency 0.4.0's 41 flagged frames: 30 off-reference (above) and 11 more (turntable_a j15-25) only for skirt cover 0.865-0.899 < 0.9 below the crotch; j7-14 carry both; looked at by eye, frames 15-25 are a normal three-quarter rotation whose lower skirt is a little narrower than the stills' hull (the hem drawn in round the feet, item 2), no flap, slit or grey; not a new defect. 8 Nov, CPU (before the decision): the founder's switch for the low band now exists and was NOT set then ("waistReading" below, src/lowRise.ts): with it set the band is read where it sits, 4.76 cm below our waist ring (99.40 cm), against the chart's waist with ease 80.5 cm plus the stated body offset +5.08 cm (the mannequin's torso 79.08 cm there against 74.00 cm at the waist ring) = 85.58 cm: band 88.07 cm, so with the switch on the skirt STILL MISSES THE CHART BY 2.49 cm BEFORE CALIBRATION (outside +-2); after the global scale (0.972, which also narrows the whole skirt 2.8 %; the hip goes from +1.35 to -1.77 against the chart) +0.01, a pass that is AUTOMATIC, not evidence of fit: the waist is this skirt's only critical point, so calibration scales the garment until it matches; flagged as low_rise_waist (and precalibration_outside_tolerance) in qa.json, the report and the import gate. The chart's waist is our AU BODY chart's (the shop prints no garment chart; its size maps onto AU_WOMENS_BODY_CHART, the median of Country Road, Seed Heritage and Blue Illusion, whose waist is the natural waist; the shop says only 'elasticated waistband', 'true to size with comfortable stretch at the waist'), so nothing in the shop's data says where the band sits: reading it low-rise is a decision, not a measurement. The hem over the feet is in the STILLS: the front still's garment mask reaches row 726, the bottom of the feet (116-121 px wide over 54 px of feet), the back's past 716; stage 2 then draws red round the feet (turntable_b 85-159) and stage 4t follows the frames: not a fit fault; a higher hem needs new stills (GPU) or the founder accepts a floor-length maxi. Looked at by the evaluating agent (every render, all 160 turntable frames), not yet by the founder

The viewer also pins the top 3 cm of any loose piece of a bottom (older unsewn bundles). STILL OPEN, flagged: (a) the texture's holdout MAE is still worse than one flat colour (29.72 against 27.97; 8x8 blocks 24.15 against 21.88): good at the front and back (21.5-24.7 against 27-30) and worst at the side views (34.9-38.4 against 26-27); blending more views (keepRatio 0.7) only ties the flat colour (27.96, a blur), sharper selection is worse (anglePower 8: 30.08), so the residual is the generated frames disagreeing on the print between views, not a seam; (b) at the crotch, from the front, the join band shows as a light hard-edged triangle under the seat and the inner legs fall together into a V fold down to the knees, and from the three-quarter view the join is a horizontal seam line across the upper thigh where the seat's print meets the legs' (all sizes; XXL crumpled at the crotch); (c) the thigh ring (72.24 cm) now lies above the join, so it measures the seat round both thighs: reported as the seat, not calibrated, graded or used by the drape log (thigh ratios not informative); (d) the invented pocket flap and the darker print of the approved Qwen stills. What the join costs, reported (review of 8 Nov): the garment's crotch is 6.5 cm BELOW the body's crotch (a deeper rise than the product; from 69.94 to 76.44 cm the seat is one tube round both thighs); the light triangle at the crotch is a flat crotch floor of band triangles between fitted vertices that no still or frame shows (up to 27.5 cm2; 31 band triangles have an edge over 8 cm, up to 19.4 cm; metrics.json fit.join.band), not something seen in the stills; and the two leg tubes cross each other just below the join, 2 crossings per slice from 69.44 down to 64.94 cm (fit.join.legOverlap), which likely feeds the V fold and the crumpled XXL crotch; not repaired. FAULTY, not for the panel yet (texture worse than one colour, the visible crotch band); the founder may judge (a)-(b) acceptable. Looked at by the evaluating agent (every render), not yet by the founder
